plan.change: Independent Hand and Place Lab: choose release cards, place with shops, reproduce recipes and sustain supply.
canonicalSources: User Hand and Place Lab request
expectedChanges: Release cards retain recipe and age lineage; three native flavor fixtures and native shop affinity.
Explicit placement and finite monthly automated orders; shortage waits; same recipe and age auto continuation only with consent, changed age requires explicit approval.
One-step delegated rebrew, one month preparation then native maturation and explicit bottling; four cask limit and no free finished stock.
Card and conventional UI comparison with interaction logs, seed and deterministic replay.
Targeted tests, phone browser checks, report and LAB entry; no main or existing Lab changes.
ownerDecisions: User full Hand and Place Lab request authorizes independent staging implementation, PR and publication; main adoption awaits author playtest.
hqDecisions: No existing contracts changed. New log is isolated and memory-only, export/replay explicit.
Native flavor chemistry and shop fit read-only. Fixed 2 bottles/store/month, 12 per bottling, no finances or rumor.
New Lab launcher and Prototype Bench entry under existing lifecycle schema.
rulesApplied: Full locked r0 before implementation, existing lifecycle generation.
Expression audit: only necessary operation cues and concrete shop speech; no ornamental copy or quality scores.
manualChecks: Phone layout and card/place/reproduce/bottle/continuation flow; conventional comparison; export/replay and return.
Public staging resources and basic interactions.
plan.rollback: Revert v02, newlauncher, report and registration/generated files only. No state migration.
outOfScope: Comprehensive E2E, battle/deck/rarity/combo/ranks/currency/new rumor/complex economy/automatic optimal selection
alternativesRejected: Automatic substitution with changed age or flavor
boundaryCases: Empty stock, failed fit, repeat placement, multiple stores sharing stock, replacement rejection preserves existing placement
Rebrew source sold out, cask capacity, preparation maturity and bottling boundaries, distinct release IDs, changed age
Replay tamper, hidden page pause, tap layout and modal scrolling
testPlan: Native fixture parity and affinity matrix; placement preserves rejected existing relation; conservation and monthly shipment boundaries.
Rebrew exact provenance, maturation, manual bottling, candidate approval, fixed-seed replay.
Targeted phone browser tests, lifecycle regression and mandatory CI.
plan.problem: Taste does not consistently determine placement and dispatch; reproduce and continue a chosen whiskey with little management.
plan.currentContract: Existing AmberTime and all old Labs remain read-only.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Prior comparison Labs do not offer a player-controlled release-to-recipe-to-next-release loop.
plan.design: Memory-only isolated playable card and conventional presentation over one deterministic rules model.
plan.compatibility: Existing main storage untouched; only new Lab log schema.
